chapter: Maple Leaf, own orchestra and rivals
title: How the Maple Leaf band broke up over a Mexican band at West End
summary: Maple Leaf lasted about three years after 1916; Grunewald hired a Mexican band instead, and the band broke up.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Well let me see. We had the Silver Leaf band up until around 1916. And then we had the Maple Leaf band until about three years we stood together. Just about three years. And then after that we broke up. And then I had my own band. You see what broke the Maple Leaf band up? We used to play at West End at Grunewald, I call that place, the summer place.
You remember where they keep all those boats?
The Yacht Club or something? No, not the Yacht.
We played at the Yacht Club too but not there.
I know the one you're talking about. Milneberg? Oh the West End Ruth.

West End. They used to have a group club. West End Ruth. Well that. We used to play there for Grunewald, you see. And he looked like he didn't like us for the next season, you see. He wore it for a Mexican band. He used that for novelty. Well he hired the Mexican band and it was a flop. They didn't make no success at all with that, you see. So he wished he had to kept the Maple Leaf band there. So the Maple Leaf band broke up after that because we didn't get that job. We thought we were sticking together because we thought we'd get that summer work again, but we didn't. So we broke up. So then I went to work and put up my own orchestra.
